jumpAndClimbRules.description: When a walking character encounters a low ledge or a window's vertical side edge, it rolls a single probability check per window encounter (stepJumpProbability = 0.45, climbProbability = 0.38). If the roll fails, that window is ignored for decisionCooldownSeconds so the character walks right past it instead of always climbing. Characters with canRestDuringClimb=false (e.g., Usagi) never pause in CLIMB_REST.

windowRidingRules.description: The overlay spans the union of all connected monitors (virtual desktop). Each monitor generates its own floor segment (floor_0, floor_1, ...) and per-monitor vertical bounds (minY..maxY). Characters can be dragged across monitors, ride windows dragged across monitors, or walk across adjacent monitors while always clamping to the floorY of whichever monitor their X coordinate currently resides on.

windowDetectionRules.description: Standard desktop windows (layer 0) are converted into walkable PlatformSegments with left/right vertical side bounds for climbing. Front windows occlude the top edges of windows behind them.
